crop_video_clip_numpy: crop a list of numpy array video frames using specified height and width coordinates
crop_video_clip_pil: crop a list of PIL Image video frames using specified bounding box coordinates
resize_video_clip_numpy: resize a list of numpy array video frames to a target size with bilinear or nearest interpolation
resize_video_clip_pil: resize a list of PIL Image video frames to a target size with bilinear or nearest interpolation
compute_resize_dimensions: compute the output height and width for resizing an image while preserving aspect ratio
